Account Privacy

Privacy

Krunk is a browser that keeps out of your business. This page says what the Krunk website and the optional Krunk account hold about you, for how long, and who else is involved. Last updated 5 November 2026.

Without an account

  • The browser sends no telemetry. It contacts this site once a day to check for an update, sending only its version, and fetches filter lists for the ad blocker.
  • This website sets no cookies, has no analytics, and our server keeps no access log.

With an account

An account is optional. It will be needed only for sync between your devices.

  • Your email address, to sign in and to send you account emails (confirmation, password reset, security notices). No newsletters, no tracking pixels.
  • Your password, stored only as a salted, slow hash (Argon2id). We can't read it.
  • Two-step verification, if you turn it on: the authenticator secret, encrypted, and the backup codes as hashes.
  • Sign-in sessions: when they started and were last used, the browser's user-agent string, the IP address and the country it came from. A session cookie keeps you signed in to this website (up to 7 days; 12 hours idle).
  • Security events (registration, sign-in, password and two-step changes) with IP address and country.

Synced data (when sync arrives)

Your bookmarks, history, open tabs, settings and passwords are encrypted on your devices before they are uploaded, with keys only your devices hold. Our server stores ciphertext it can't read. It does see how much you store, when your devices sync, and which devices are linked. The Krunk website never asks for your sync passphrase or recovery key.

How long we keep it

  • IP addresses are removed after 90 days. Countries stay while the session exists.
  • Ended sign-in sessions are deleted after 30 days.
  • Accounts never confirmed are deleted after 7 days.
  • Your account is kept until you delete it; unused accounts are not deleted automatically.
  • Backups of the database are kept for 14 days.

Deleting your account

Deletion removes the account and everything attached to it from our database at once. Backups still hold it until they expire, within 14 days; if we ever restore one, deleted accounts are deleted again. Until the delete button arrives with sync, email privacy@209.wf from your account's address and we delete it.

Who else is involved

  • Cloudflare delivers this site. It handles every connection, so it sees your IP address and the pages you request, under its own privacy policy. The account forms use Cloudflare Turnstile to keep bots out; it runs a check in your browser and doesn't use cookies to track you.
  • Our email provider delivers the account emails, so it handles your email address and the message.

We don't sell or share your data with anyone else, and we show no ads.

Contact

Questions, a copy of your data, or deletion: privacy@209.wf.
